themeVerdicts.explanation: Named roofed market street in a fixed Kyoto arcade, with documented market authorization at the site in 1615 and approximately 130 operating food and goods shops.
Permanent publicly accessible covered food market in Barcelona; its present-site market structure was inaugurated in 1853, with the current metal roof added in 1914, and it remains operational.

Permanent named market complex officially opened in 1878 and still operates with covered halls and sheds, food and non-food retail, and public access. Its mixed open-air components do not trigger the exclusion for markets that are entirely open-air.
Named covered bazaar complex in Istanbul whose core construction began in 1455–56; it remains a fixed, publicly accessible retail complex with thousands of shops and regular hours.
Permanent indoor municipal market opened in 1897 at its Budapest site, with operating stalls, published hours, and food and merchandise retail.
Permanent enclosed public market opened in 1893 and remains operational with independent food, produce, prepared-food, and merchandise vendors.
Historic named bazaar in Cairo established in the fourteenth century and still operating as a contiguous covered public retail market area.
Individually named covered market in a fixed City of London complex, with market use on the site since the fourteenth century and current public shops and food businesses.
Public markets have occupied the Toronto site since 1803; the operating South Market building dates from 1845 and functions as a permanent covered food market.
Permanent covered municipal market opened in 1874 and continuing as a public retail complex with food, clothing, and household shops.
Málaga’s permanent municipal market occupies a fixed historic complex; the present iron hall dates from the nineteenth century and remains an operating public food market.
Covered public central market established in 1891 in Tunis and still operating with regular food and produce vendors.
Fixed Jerusalem market complex established in 1887, now operating year-round with covered streets, public stalls, and shops selling food and other goods.
Historic covered municipal market opened in 1869 in Mumbai and still operating as a public retail market for food and household merchandise.
Permanent covered public food market beside Metz Cathedral with nineteenth-century market use and regular operating vendors.
Named permanent covered municipal market in Nancy dating from the nineteenth century and still operating with public food and provisions stalls.
Permanent covered public food and produce market established in 1869 on its present Adelaide city site and still operating with independent traders.
Historic covered public market hall completed in 1826 and still operating with visitor-accessible food vendors and shops in a fixed Boston complex.
Nineteenth-century covered market hall in Colmar that remains an operating public market for produce, meat, fish, and other foods.
This covered Paris market dates to the seventeenth century and continues to operate with public food stalls. The verified source and mapped coordinates support its inclusion in this board.

clueVerdicts.explanation: The centuries-old fish trade and narrow covered street of specialist food shops identify Nishiki Market without depending on its precise length, shop count, or construction dates.
The post-conquest foundation around two domed trading halls and growth into a city-like maze of streets, inns, workshops, and shops identify the Grand Bazaar.
The municipal food-distribution history, vast steel hall, colorful tiled roof, and continuing produce-and-spice trade identify Budapest’s Great Market Hall without exact dimensions or dates.
The medieval market outside a city gate, later boulevard-and-opera-house setting, and metal-roofed permanent hall identify La Boqueria without requiring exact years.
The nineteenth-century market’s expansion over a former cemetery and its continuing mix of food halls, sheds, and general stalls identify Queen Victoria Market without acreage or dates.

repairs.summary: Replaced clustered distractors and rescored all relationships to enforce the 10 km minimum.
Rewrote clue prose around recognizable historical narratives and removed reliance on obscure names, exact figures, and technical specifications.
